product_overview: A cutting-edge exam system leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Google Gemini AI to generate intelligent exams from uploaded PDF notes and provide an interactive, real-time exam taking experience.
core_goals: Enable educators and students to generate high-quality exams automatically from study notes.
Provide a seamless exam taking interface with progress tracking and instant scoring feedback.
Integrate robust AI-powered question generation using vector search and natural language models.
Ensure system performance meets real-time response requirements for exam interactions.
Allow efficient management of subjects, notes, exams and user authentication securely.
key_features: AI-powered exam generation from uploaded PDF notes with customizable question count and difficulty.
Real-time exam taking with progress tracking, answer submission, scoring, and feedback display.
Comprehensive exam list and management UI with filtering, deletion, and detail viewing capabilities.
User authentication and session management using Supabase Auth.
PDF parsing and embedding generation using Google Gemini text-embedding-004 model for semantic vector search.
Cloudflare R2 integration for secure file storage of uploaded notes.
Database schema supporting subjects, notes, exams, questions, answers, and performance tracking.
Reusable UI components for consistent and responsive user experience.
user_flow_summary: Generate Exam Flow: User selects subject, configures exam parameters, AI generates exam questions from relevant note chunks, user reviews and starts exam.
Take Exam Flow: User loads exam, answers questions one-by-one with real-time progress updates, submits answers, and views scored feedback.
View Results Flow: User reviews completed exams, sees detailed score, answers correctness, and explanations for study improvement.
validation_criteria: Exam generation should succeed at least 95% of the time within 30 seconds for 10 questions.
Exam loading times must be under 2 seconds for optimal UX.
Answer submission and scoring responses should complete within 1 second.
Progress tracking must update in real-time without lag.
Empty or missing answers should be gracefully handled without counting toward score.
Subjects with no uploaded notes disable exam generation with appropriate error messages.
Prevent duplicate exam submissions through UI state management.
System uptime must exceed 99% to ensure availability.
